latest_release.name: PrestaShop 9.2.1
latest_release.body:
# Full Changelog
Click here to see

- Back Office: - Bug fix: - #43171: Keep the creation order of order messages created in the same second (by @mattgoud) - #43159: Only open the row link when the press started on a clickable cell (by @mattgoud) - GHSA-95w6-v2wq-cv8w Download theme archives from a URL into the cache directory (by @mattgoud) - GHSA-fxq4-2mc8-99pr Only load translation files of installed modules and reject PHP archives in import uploads (by @nicosomb) - GHSA-95f5-jc9c-gg3q Validate the debug cookie name and value before writing the debug mode (by @mattgoud) - Front Office: - Bug fix: - GHSA-fg9q-mm4c-h5xc Require the order secure key to download a customization file by reference (by @M0rgan01) - Core: - Bug fix: - Update dependencies, including ps_emailsubscription 3.0.1 (by @jolelievre) - Update Symfony components to 6.4.50 (by @mattgoud) - #43443: Update psgdpr to 1.4.4 (by @nicosomb) - GHSA-wrmc-gmx5-9hhc Keep attachment files inside the download directory (by @nicosomb) - GHSA-6c2j-pgwm-95m9 Cut the Admin API access of a disabled or deleted API client (by @M0rgan01) - GHSA-99cp-c6mm-p7h5 Block corrupted SVG files uploaded through the FileManager and the logo uploader (by @Quetzacoalt91) - GHSA-2676-hc74-gg7v Prevent duplicate orders from a single cart in concurrent checkouts (by @M0rgan01) - GHSA-mgcf-mrg4-mcxv Require the order edit permission to add a product to an existing order (by @M0rgan01) - GHSA-r246-6gw4-pj3p Take the cart rule quantity when the order validation checks it (by @mattgoud) - GHSA-7q68-ch46-pxmc Keep extracted archives and installed themes inside their destination folder (by @nicosomb) - GHSA-5p6p-mx64-96jf Always validate the mail template name before writing translation files (by @mattgoud) - GHSA-p292-3rh4-vm4p Fix privilege escalation via unrestricted scope assignment on API clients (by @matthieu-rolland) - GHSA-g6p7-cx52-hcrj Generate the password reset tokens with a CSPRNG (by @clotairer) - Installer: - Bug fix: - GHSA-8rxw-79mh-gmm5 Refuse to run the web installer on an already installed shop (by @mattgoud) - GHSA-h2q4-7fp7-m5jp Fix dangerous unserialization in the installer session (by @clotairer) - Web Services: - Bug fix: - GHSA-hjwq-7qvv-qxj4 Keep webservice record access within the shops a key is allowed on (by @clotairer) - GHSA-3f36-4qv4-vfgh Keep webservice keys within the shops they are allowed on (by @clotairer) - Tests: - Bug fix: - Create the API client enabled in the authorization endpoint UI test (by @mattgoud) - #43368: Update tests UI dependencies (by @Quetzacoalt91)
